name: Synthesis of Co(ttpp)
plain_text_description:
Heat a 50 mL two-neck RBF in an oven (120 °C) for >1.5 h.
[03.12., RT 23.9°C, RH 26 %]
Assemble and fix a reflux condenser, a T-shape connector, and a bubbler (paraffin oil) at a Schlenk line.
Take out the RBF and quickly assemble it with a stir bar, rubber septum, and the reflux condenser while hot.
Evacuate (0.33 mbar), heat the bottom part of the reflux condenser with a heat gun (250 °C). [Also the flask, because it cooled down while figuring out the assembly]
Backfill with N2
Add TAPP and TrBr (plastic spatula) quickly
Cycle with N2 slowly x3
Add Et3N
Add THF w/ double-tipped needle. [15:00] (black mixture)
Start stirring (350 rpm)
Cover the flask with Al foil.
→ 0.1 mL + CDCl3 500 µL, sonicate → 1H NMR M1
[4.12. 7:40] → 0.1 mL + CDCl3 500 µL, sonicate → 1H NMR M2
[8.12. 8:30] → 0.1 mL + CDCl3 500 µL, sonicate → 1H NMR M3
Stop stirring. Close the N2 connection. Add CoCl2 quickly. Purge with N2 for 10 s. Close. Resume stirring.
Bubble with N2, 30 min.
Heat to reflux (85 °C, 1.25 atm) for 2 h
Cool down to RT.
→ 0.1 mL + CDCl3 500 µL, sonicate → 1H NMR M4
plain_text_observation:
Frit funnel 25 mL and add a folded filter paper add alumina (neutral) until the half of the filter paper
wet it with THF.
Charged the half of reaction mixture [it did not elute]. (A)
Add a new filter paper (15 A, cut) and neutral alumina 12.5 mL to a new 25 mL frit funnel. [the paper left some gap at the rim of the frit. Maybe better not to use paper next time]
Attach the funnel to a vacuum filter adapter and a 250 mL RBF.
Wet the alumina with THF
Load the rest of the reaction mixture
Charge the loaded alumina (A)
Elute with THF 70 mL and weak suction. (eluate: dark red to pale pink)  (The alumina pad became green with some blue parts at the top, green at the middle, and green with some brown parts at the bottom)
Add EtOH 25 mL to the eluate
Concentrate with rotovap to 25 mL. (purple precipitation)
Collect the solids by filtration with a filter paper (15A, ø 90 mm, tare: 0.53750 g), a glass funnel, a vacuum filter adapter, and a 50 mL RBF under suction. (filtrate: dark brown)
Rinse with EtOH and petroleum ether.
Dry the filtrate with rotovap
Add EtOH 25 mL. o/n
[10.12. 21.0 °C, RH 36%]
Sonicate (dark green-brown)
Collect the solids by filtration with a filter paper (15A, ø 90 mm, tare: x g), a glass funnel, a vacuum filter adapter, and a 50 mL RBF (tare: ?) under suction. (filtrate: dark green brown)
Rinse with EtOH and petroleum ether.
